_notes: lp-li-3 (18-30 skincare-makeup-hybrid). FULL UGC aesthetic: every image uses skip_modifier (raw phone-photo look, no editorial polish). Product shots still route to /edit so the bottle/label render accurately; lifestyle shots are text-to-image. Reason/review/product render 1:1; hero is 16:9. Models read as real, relatable, not-a-model people.

prompts.name: lp-li-3-hero
prompts.prompt: A candid, authentic phone photo of a real young woman around 23 with glowy but real skin (relatable, not a model), sitting by a window in her bedroom holding the foundation bottle and smiling naturally at the camera. Everyday lived-in setting, soft natural window light with the flat look of a phone camera, faint grain, slightly imperfect candid framing, landscape orientation with the girl to one side and her room behind. Looks like a real photo a customer would post — not a studio or editorial shoot. The bottle is clearly visible and in focus.

prompts.name: lp-li-3-reason-1
prompts.prompt: An authentic phone photo of a customer demonstrating the product: the foundation bottle held in one hand while the other bare forearm shows a swatch of the PURE WHITE cream half-blended into the skin, shot casually from the user's own POV in everyday indoor lighting. Slightly grainy, real skin, imperfect framing — clearly showing the white formula adapting to a skin-matched tone. Not a studio shot.

prompts.name: lp-li-3-reason-2
prompts.prompt: A close-up phone selfie of a real young woman's cheek and under-eye showing breathable, my-skin-but-better coverage — even but real, with natural texture and a couple of visible pores, definitely not cakey. Flat phone-camera lighting, faint grain, candid. Looks like a real review close-up, not editorial.

prompts.name: lp-li-3-reason-3
prompts.prompt: A casual phone selfie of a real young woman around 24 showing off her dewy, lit-from-within 'glass skin' glow, natural happy expression. Everyday indoor setting, soft light with phone-camera flatness, faint grain, candid imperfect framing. Authentic review-photo vibe — not a model, not a studio shot.

prompts.name: lp-li-3-reason-4
prompts.prompt: A real, un-retouched phone selfie close-up of a young woman's face showing how the foundation softly blurs pores and texture while still looking like real skin — part of her face in sharp focus. Flat front-camera lighting, slight grain, candid framing. Looks like an honest 'no filter' review photo.

prompts.name: lp-li-3-reason-5
prompts.prompt: A candid phone photo of a real young woman in her early 20s sitting at her laptop at home, healthy glowing skin lit by the screen and a lamp, casual messy desk around her. Everyday, slightly grainy, un-staged. Looks like a real snapshot, not a stock or editorial photo.

prompts.name: lp-li-3-reason-6
prompts.prompt: An authentic phone 'shelfie': the foundation bottle sitting on a real bathroom shelf or counter among actual skincare products — a serum dropper, a moisturizer jar, a few everyday items — soft real bathroom lighting, slightly cluttered and lived-in, casual from-above or counter angle, faint grain. Looks like a real customer's shelf showing it's a skincare-makeup hybrid, not a styled studio set.

prompts.name: lp-li-3-reason-7
prompts.prompt: A casual phone photo of a hand holding the foundation bottle turned to show it, in everyday indoor lighting against a simple real background (a bedroom or bathroom) with a small green plant nearby. Relatable, slightly grainy, un-styled. Looks like a real customer photo, not a clean-beauty studio still life. The label stays readable.

prompts.name: lp-li-3-reason-8
prompts.prompt: An authentic group selfie of three real young women (around 20-28) with different skin tones — fair, medium/olive, and deep — squished together smiling at the phone, all with healthy glowing real skin. Casual everyday setting, flat front-camera lighting, faint grain, candid imperfect framing. Looks like a real friends' selfie, not a diverse-cast studio shoot.

prompts.name: lp-li-3-reason-9
prompts.prompt: An authentic behind-the-scenes phone photo: the foundation bottle on a real desk or vanity next to a phone propped on a small stand (screen blank, no text or logos) and a ring light, as if a creator just filmed a review — casual, lived-in, slightly cluttered, faint grain. Do not invent any award badges, logos, or on-screen text. Looks like a real snapshot.

prompts.name: lp-li-3-reason-10
prompts.prompt: An authentic unboxing phone photo: the foundation bottle just taken out of a blush-pink shipping mailer on a bed or lap, tissue paper and the open package around it, held in one hand. Everyday bedroom lighting, faint grain, casual POV framing. Looks like a real customer's unboxing photo. Leave any card blank (no text).

prompts.name: lp-li-3-product
prompts.prompt: An authentic but clear phone photo of the foundation bottle held in a hand or standing on a clean real bathroom counter in nice soft natural light — the bottle prominent, well-lit, and fully in focus with its label readable. Casual and real (not a studio packshot) but flattering enough to show the product clearly. Faint grain, simple real background.

prompts.name: lp-li-3-review-1
prompts.prompt: A raw, authentic front-facing phone selfie that looks like a real customer review photo — NOT a professional shoot, NOT editorial, no shallow depth of field. A relatable, ordinary young woman around 23 (real person, not a model) holding the foundation bottle up next to her cheek, smiling at her phone. Combination/oily skin that's glowy but real, with a few visible pores and the odd tiny blemish. Messy everyday bedroom behind her, flat ordinary indoor lighting with a faint phone-flash sheen, mild sensor grain, slight overexposure, slightly tilted and imperfect framing. The bottle is held clearly in frame and in focus.

prompts.name: lp-li-3-review-2
prompts.prompt: An authentic bathroom mirror selfie taken on a phone — the phone is visibly held in one hand, the foundation bottle held up toward the mirror in the other. A real young woman around 26 with fair, pink-undertone skin, casual and candid, not a model. Everyday cluttered bathroom, slightly harsh overhead lighting, mild grain, a touch of motion blur, off-center amateur framing. Looks exactly like a real customer's review photo posted online — not retouched, not studio. The bottle label stays clear and readable.

prompts.name: lp-li-3-review-3
prompts.prompt: A casual phone selfie of a real young woman around 25 with a natural glow (relatable, not a model), giving a relaxed smile while holding the foundation bottle up right next to her cheek with her free hand. IMPORTANT: the foundation bottle must be clearly visible, prominent, held beside her face and in sharp focus with its label readable — she is showing it off to the camera the way customers do in review photos. Ordinary living-room or bedroom setting, soft window light mixed with the flat look of a phone front camera, faint grain, slightly off-center candid framing. Genuine UGC review-photo vibe — unpolished, un-retouched, real.
